Garden SuburbJunior & Infant School
Welcome to Garden Suburb Schools
Garden Suburb Infant and Junior Schools are situated at the southern end of the London Borough of Barnet, in Hampstead Garden Suburb. We offer high quality education for children between the ages of four and eleven in a stimulating, challenging, happy and safe environment. Although we are separate schools, we work closely together. We share a school site and governing body. The children from the Infant School have priority for places in the Junior School at the age of seven. Read More »

WELCOME TO OUR SCHOOL
The school is situated in Hampstead Garden Suburb, at the southern end of the London Borough of Barnet. We are a three form entry co-educational community junior school for children between the ages of 7-11 years.
The school was originally opened in 1912. Part of the building was rebuilt in 1960 to replace damage caused during 1939-45 War. There is an infant school on the same site and there are strong links between the two schools
‘PER ARDUA AD ASTRA’
which literally means ‘Reach for the Stars’ however we also interpret this to mean
‘WORK HARD TO SUCCEED’.
Our vision is to cultivate excellence and enjoyment in learning and teaching, within a stimulating and caring environment, where the achievements of all are celebrated.
